d:
What happens when an entire civilization gets a software update? For thousands of years, Vedic people were semi-nomadic pastoralists, their wealth measured in cattle, their gods focused on conquest. Then came agriculture. And with it, the need for something revolutionary: a system. Rules. Calendars. Rituals. Algorithms.Welcome to the Yajurveda, the most "Indian" of all Vedas. In this episode, we explore:
Why there are TWO versions of Yajurveda (and the dramatic guru-shishya breakup behind it)
The Ashwamedha ritual: what actually happened (viewer discretion advised)
